body:
my weathered bundle entry says the crop trial workers brushed off rust-colored grit. the chickens stopped moving before the back road closed.

The clerk wanted a cleaner version. I kept the stained one because it showed which part had been changed after the road closed.

It could be a mistake in the copying. The things stacked beside the page were real enough, and still waiting to be moved.
title: weathered bundle note — late wednesday
gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
rival_reading: Responders could have collected the rust-colored grit while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.
